originalTitle: Should You Buy The Dip In MongoDB Stock?
summary: MongoDB (MDB) stock has fallen 26% from its late-August high. Over the past month it lost 24%, while the S&P 500 slipped just 0.5%. When a stock falls that fast, many investors want to buy while the price is low. But you only gain from a lower price if the business itself is still healthy. So is this a chance to buy MongoDB cheaper, or a warning about the business.
content:
MongoDB (MDB) stock has fallen 26% from its late-August high. Over the past month it lost 24%, while the S&P 500 slipped just 0.5%. When a stock falls that fast, many investors want to buy while the price is low. But you only gain from a lower price if the business itself is still healthy. So is this a chance to buy MongoDB cheaper, or a warning about the business?

MongoDB Fell Mostly On A Leadership Change

MongoDB fell mainly because its CEO left. On September 28, the company said its CEO had stepped down to join Meta Platforms. MongoDB shares fell more than 18% that morning.

Revenue for fiscal Q2 2027 was $772 million, up 30% from a year earlier. Management said the quarter came in above all of its guidance ranges. The shares still fell after that report on September 1. MarketWatch said investors were likely disappointed that Atlas, the cloud database, grew at the same pace for a fifth quarter.

MongoDB named an interim CEO, who takes over a business that had just beaten its own forecasts. MongoDB stock has had bigger drops before, and what followed them is a useful guide.

Have Past Drops In MongoDB Stock Paid Off?

Mostly yes, though buyers first sat through further losses. Here a drop means a fall of 30% or more within 30 trading days. MongoDB stock has had seven such drops since 2017.

Five of the six old enough to judge were higher a year later. The median gain over that year was 45%. The seventh, from March 2026, is still too recent to judge. Today’s 26% fall is smaller than those drops, so they show how such falls went, not what this one will do.

Collecting those gains took patience. Across the six older drops, the median further fall after the drop was 28%. Three of the seven drops were followed by a further fall of 20% or more.

The best gain within a year had a median of 95%. Reaching it took a median of 270 days, about nine months.

Those results come from past years, so MongoDB’s business today counts just as much.

What Are You Paying For MongoDB’s Business Now?

You are paying more than the market for each dollar of sales, for a business that is still growing fast. Revenue over the past twelve months rose 26% from a year earlier.

MongoDB also turns its sales into cash. Operating cash flow, the cash its day-to-day business brings in, was 24% of revenue over the past twelve months. MongoDB still shows a small operating loss, equal to 0.5% of revenue. Three years ago that loss was 18.4% of revenue, and it has shrunk each year since.

MongoDB stock trades at 9.7 times its yearly sales , against 3.1 times for the S&P 500. So even after the fall, you pay about three times the market’s price for each dollar of sales.

The main new risk is leadership, because the next report will be the first since the CEO left. In September, management raised its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to $2.99 billion to $3.03 billion. It guided fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $756 million to $761 million, growth of 20% to 21% from a year earlier. The fiscal Q3 2027 report is expected on or around November 30, 2026.

If you buy MongoDB now, you are betting that it keeps growing through the change at the top. After past drops, patient buyers were mostly rewarded, but only after further losses. If fiscal Q3 revenue lands at or above management’s guide, revenue will have held to plan through the leadership change. If revenue falls short, the business would be growing more slowly than its own forecast. You would then be paying about three times the market’s price for each dollar of sales.

Before you decide on MDB, consider a better choice. And it did so without taking concentrated risk that comes with retail stock picking.
chineseTitle: MongoDB 股票下跌时你应该买入吗？
chineseSummary: MongoDB (MDB) 股价较 8 月底高点下跌 26%。过去一个月，该指数下跌了 24%，而标准普尔 500 指数仅下跌 0.5%。当一只股票下跌得如此之快时，许多投资者都想在价格较低时买入。但只有当业务本身仍然健康时，你才能从较低的价格中获益。那么这是一个以更便宜的价格购买 MongoDB 的机会，还是对业务的警告。
chineseContent:
MongoDB (MDB) 股价较 8 月底高点下跌 26%。过去一个月，该指数下跌了 24%，而标准普尔 500 指数仅下跌 0.5%。当一只股票下跌得如此之快时，许多投资者都想在价格较低时买入。但只有当业务本身仍然健康时，你才能从较低的价格中获益。那么这是一个以更便宜的价格购买 MongoDB 的机会，还是对业务的警告？

MongoDB 的下跌主要是由于领导层变动

MongoDB的下跌主要是因为其CEO的离职。 9 月 28 日，该公司表示其首席执行官已辞职，加入 Meta Platforms。当天上午，MongoDB 股价下跌超过 18%。

2027 财年第二季度收入为 7.72 亿美元，同比增长 30%。管理层表示，该季度的业绩超出了其所有指导范围。 9 月 1 日发布该报告后，该股仍下跌。MarketWatch 表示，投资者可能对云数据库 Atlas 第 5 季度以同样的速度增长感到失望。

MongoDB 任命了一位临时首席执行官，他接管了一家刚刚超出其预期的业务。 MongoDB 股票之前曾出现过较大跌幅，随后的跌幅是一个有用的指南。

MongoDB 股票过去的下跌是否得到了回报？

大部分是肯定的，尽管买家首先承受了进一步的损失。这里的下跌是指30个交易日内下跌30%或以上。自 2017 年以来，MongoDB 股价已出现七次下跌。

一年后，六名年龄足以判断的人中，有五人的成绩更高。那一年的平均涨幅为 45%。第七次是 2026 年 3 月开始的，现在还无法判断。今天 26% 的跌幅比那些跌幅要小，因此它们显示了此类跌幅的情况，而不是这次跌幅的后果。

收集这些成果需要耐心。在六次较早的下跌中，下跌后进一步下跌的中位数为 28%。 7 次下跌中有 3 次随后进一步下跌 20% 或更多。

一年内最好的涨幅中位数为 95%。达到这一目标平均需要 270 天，即大约 9 个月。

这些结果来自过去几年，因此 MongoDB 今天的业务同样重要。

您现在为 MongoDB 业务支付了什么费用？

对于仍在快速增长的企业，您为每一美元的销售额支付的费用都高于市场价格。过去 12 个月的收入同比增长 26%。

MongoDB 还将其销售额转化为现金。过去 12 个月，运营现金流（即日常业务带来的现金）占收入的 24%。 MongoDB 仍然显示出较小的运营亏损，相当于收入的 0.5%。三年前，这一损失占收入的 18.4%，此后每年都在缩小。

MongoDB 股票的交易价格是其年销售额的 9.7 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的交易价格是 3.1 倍。因此，即使在下跌之后，您为每一美元的销售额支付的费用约为市场价格的三倍。

主要的新风险是领导力，因为下一份报告将是首席执行官离开后的第一份报告。 9月，管理层将2027财年收入预测上调至29.9亿美元至30.3亿美元。该公司预计 2027 年第三季度营收为 7.56 亿美元至 7.61 亿美元，同比增长 20% 至 21%。 2027 年第三季度财报预计将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日左右发布。

如果你现在购买 MongoDB，你就可以确信它会通过高层的变动而不断增长。在经历了过去的下跌之后，耐心的买家大多都得到了回报，但前提是进一步遭受损失。如果第三财季收入达到或高于管理层的指导，收入将在领导层变更期间保持在计划范围内。如果收入低于预期，该业务的增长速度将比其自己的预测慢。然后，您将为每一美元的销售额支付大约三倍于市场价格的价格。

在决定使用 MDB 之前，请考虑更好的选择。自成立以来，Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合已经超越了结合三大指数（S&P 500、S&P Mid-cap 和 Russell 2000）的基准。而且它没有承担散户选股带来的集中风险。
